customManagers.description: The Grafana plugins that Grafana preinstalls, pinned as <id>@<version> in the plugins value (#2022).

packageRules.description: Renovate reads an Application source with no chart as a git dependency. Argo CD tracks main on purpose (ADR 0013), so those dependencies stay off.

Each Grafana plugin release names the Grafana it needs as grafanaDependency, which Renovate cannot read. A minor release can need a newer Grafana minor, so each plugin gets its own pull request, held to the major that the running Grafana major needs.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, check that the Grafana image of the `grafana` chart meets the `grafanaDependency` of this release: https://grafana.com/api/plugins/{{{depName}}}/versions/{{{newVersion}}}. Grafana installs the pinned version at start.

packageRules.description: A base image update of the service image is a fix, so release-please releases it. Other updates stay chore and release nothing alone.
